text:
Maya Patel: Quick recap from today's audit coverage workshop — flagged gaps across API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. Notes + actions below. TL;DR: schema v2 for runtime events, auth needs session-change + token revoke events, billing missing invoice-access & price-change events.

Eli Zhang: agreed. We should version explicitly (audit_schema) and include event_context for traceability. Example payload to anchor discussions:```{
  "event_type": "token.create",
  "actor": {"id": "u-123", "role": "admin"},
  "resource": {"type": "api_key", "id": "k-456"},
  "audit_schema": "v2",
  "metadata": {"ip": "198.51.100.7"}
}```

Samir Kapoor: Prioritization idea: auth (session/token lifecycle) = P0, billing (invoice-access) = P0, runtime (model serving schema) = P1, console UI events = P1, API gateway fine-grained routing events = P2. Reason: customer-facing/regulatory risk first.

Joan Li: We also need a customer-facing validation flow — sandboxed "audit replay" in console staging so customers can validate event shapes and retention. Will add acceptance tests + CLI tool to generate sample events.

security-bot: CI: audit-schema-lint failed on branch feature/audit-v2 (eng/infra/tests/audit_schema_test.py:34) :rotating_light:

Maya Patel: Owners assigned: Eli -> schema PR, Joan -> validation harness + console UX, Samir -> billing event coverage + example mappings, Infra Team -> ingest/backfill pipeline. Goal: initial PRs and ticket breakdown by 2026-04-02.

Infra Team: We need a migration/compatibility plan: propose a compatibility shim in ingestion that maps v1 -> v2 field names and flags, and a roll-forward window of 90 days. Also need to estimate SLO impact for prefix/KV cache hashes.

Eli Zhang: I'll draft the schema PR today. Plan: add audit_schema field, enum for event_type, optional event_context (trace_id, span_id), and a metadata map. Will include compatibility layer and lint rule.

Joan Li: Creating tickets: CONSOLE-321 (audit replay UI), QA-222 (audit acceptance tests). Will mock data: 10K events/day per tenant for perf tests.

Samir Kapoor: Add monitoring: per-service "missing expected event" rate, and alert if >0.1% of auth ops have no audit event. Also need to log RBAC-change events with before/after snapshots.

Maya Patel: I'll update the backlog triage doc and create epics. Linking notes: <https://redwood-internal/notes/audit-gapworkshop> — please add any missing items.

Eli Zhang: one action item — decide on canonical timestamp field (event_ts vs created_at). leaning toward event_ts (RFC3339) + epoch_ms for indexing.

Joan Li: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate console mocks with Eli's schema.

Samir Kapoor: :eyes: I'll re-run vulnerability triage for any ingress points while schema changes land.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Will follow up with a short async doc and tomorrow's 10am sync if needed. :white_check_mark:
